summary: PR is not ready at HEAD 9be369d82332a4764b3462053f584522e6d8d706: the exact-run Lightsail/backfill path appears safely scoped for a single-run rollout, but the current-head VibePro gate state still records unresolved release/coverage evidence and `ready_for_pr_create=false`.
inspection_summary: Verified requested HEAD match on branch `codex/meeting-pack-eve-candidates-vibepro`; inspected branch scope against `origin/develop` (35 commits, 18 changed files), reviewed the gate request plus `.vibepro` decision/traceability/verification artifacts, read Story/architecture/responsibility docs, checked release runbook and rollback contract in `docs/runbooks/eve-meeting-note-backfill.md`, inspected `script/backfill-eve-meeting-note-dispatch.mjs`, `server/services/external-runner/eve-meeting-note-reconciler.js`, `server/services/workflow/workflow-service.js`, `server/services/meeting-source/meeting-source-mcp-sync-service.js`, and reviewed targeted tests/UI evidence for source-hash scoping, owner SSOT resolution, mismatch observability, and operator-review failure handling.
judgment_delta: Initial concern: the Lightsail replay/backfill path might still permit unsafe bulk execution or cross-run contamination. Final judgment: the runbook, CLI guardrails, and reconciler/workflow checks consistently enforce exact-run scope via `--run-id`, `force_new_session`, and matching `org_id`/`project_id`/`run_id`/`source_text_hash`, with additive rollback and no irreversible migration.

Initial concern: current-head evidence might be stale from a prior review cycle. Final judgment: verification artifacts are bound to HEAD `9be369d82332a4764b3462053f584522e6d8d706`, but PR readiness still fails because the gate artifacts themselves remain unresolved on this same HEAD (`overall_status=needs_verification`, `ready_for_pr_create=false`, release-ops block, stale/missing gate coverage).

findings.title: Current-head gate state still blocks PR creation
findings.detail: `.vibepro/pr/story-eve-meeting-candidates-pull-reconciler/pr-prepare.json` and `decision-index.json` both remain on the reviewed HEAD and still report `overall_status=needs_verification`, `ready_for_pr_create=false`, unresolved gate count 52, critical unresolved gate count 24, and a blocking `gate:judgment_axis_release_ops` due to unresolved release note, rollback instruction, and observability evidence. That is sufficient to hold PR readiness even though code/test evidence is stronger than the gate state suggests.

findings.title: Branch scope is still marked `needs_clean_branch`
findings.detail: The reviewed branch is ahead of `origin/codex/meeting-pack-eve-candidates` by 2 and contains 35 commits relative to `origin/develop`, while the story diff touches 18 files. The changed files are mostly story-scoped, but VibePro still classifies the branch scope as `needs_clean_branch`, so the evidence package has not yet demonstrated a clean PR surface suitable for release review.

findings.title: Mandatory path-surface and acceptance traceability are still incomplete
findings.detail: `traceability.json` and the gate artifacts still leave `gate:path_surface_matrix` at `partial_surface` and `gate:failure_mode_coverage` at `missing_coverage`, with weak mappings called out for AC-004, AC-005, and AC-007. The code and tests cover much of this behavior, but the review package has not closed the evidence loop required by the gate request.
